title: Envelope
description: The nine-key v2 response envelope. Every /v2 endpoint returns exactly these keys, in this order, on every 200 (spec-00 1.1).

endpoint.description: The endpoint path that produced this response.

computed_at.description: A revision stamp, never a wall clock: identical requests return identical bytes, so a fixed_instant or reference response can be cached for a year and 304 stays reachable.

query.description: The request as understood: every resolved input (instant, location, presentation options) plus `ignored`, in the order spec-00 13.2 defines. Shape is endpoint-specific.

data.description: The answer. Shape is endpoint-specific; see each operation's summary and /api/reference.html.

warnings.description: Machine-readable notices about this response. Empty when none apply; never changes the HTTP status.

links.description: Related URLs. self reproduces this exact response; docs is always present; others (page, spec, next, first, explain) appear where relevant.

meta.description: Provenance: engine version, rights and attribution, cache class, accuracy statement, tzdb version, and endpoint-specific conventions (refraction model, horizon definitions, time scales, and so on). Never subject to `fields` projection.

attribution.description: The credit line, byte-identical to meta.attribution.text.

docs.description: The human-readable reference section for this endpoint.

Warning.description: One machine-readable notice. Exactly four keys, in this order (spec-00 11.4). Never changes the HTTP status.

code.description: A stable, lower_snake_case token. The full registry is at GET /v2/enums?set=warning_codes.

message.description: A human-readable explanation. Not parsed by machines; use `code`.

field.description: The data or query pointer the warning is about, dot-addressed the same way `fields` is. Null when the warning is not about one field.

value.description: The value involved, when there is a single obvious one to show. Null otherwise.
